root.title: Inbox.lv – free email from the most loved Latvian brand
root.description: Inbox.lv is a free, secure Latvian email service: 20 GB mailbox, 50 MB attachments, mobile apps and free support in Latvian, Russian and English.
root.heroAlt: Inbox.lv email on a laptop and a phone
features: 95% of INBOX.LV users recognize its simple and convenient use as the main advantage of our e-mail system
Using a computer, phone or tablet, INBOX.LV e-mail is available wherever you are. INBOX.LV free mobile application provides access to e-mail everywhere. Be with us always!
The size of our e-mail box is 20 GB, the maximum size of a letter is 50 MB. This is significantly more than what our competitors offer
No matter what happens to your computer or phone, modern INBOX.LV cloud service technologies ensure up to 99.95% continuous access to e-mail and the highest security for all data.

Taking care of the INBOX.LV user is our priority No. 1! We provide free technical assistance and support both via e-mail and by phone in Latvian, Russian or English. You can find out about our services and their technical capabilities in the Help section.
Since its foundation, now more than 15 years, INBOX.LV is and remains a 100% Latvian product. For several years in a row, INBOX.LV has been recognized as the most loved domestic brand
reviews: When studying, it is constantly necessary to send a lot of lecture materials, synopsis pictures. In such moments, INBOX.LV is a real miracle - everything fits into one letter and sending emails can be organized by contacts. It's really cool!

I value my time. If I have a problem, I want everything to be explained to me in a human way, and not made to look for answers somewhere, I don't know where, or, even worse, to fill out electronic forms. That's why I chose INBOX.LV - if a problem arises, one phone call and everything becomes clear!
I work as a taxi driver, so it's actually very convenient for me to use e-mail on my phone. Whether I'm on the road, fishing or relaxing with friends - I'm always reachable!

themes.title: Vote for the new Inbox.lv mail themes
themes.description: Preview 48 colour themes for Inbox.lv mail in a live demo mailbox and vote for your favourites. No account, name or email needed.
themes.h1: Help choose the next Inbox Mail themes
themes.intro: Preview the colors, then tick your favorites. Choose as many themes as you like, but select at least one from each of the four groups before submitting.
themes.mobileNote: Tap a color to open the mailbox preview. Ticking a checkbox selects it for your vote.
themes.demographicsNote: Age and gender are optional. They help us understand how theme preferences differ between groups.
themes.privacy: No name, email or account is requested. We save your selected themes, optional age group and gender, submission time and a random browser identifier in Supabase (Europe). Responses are available to the survey owner for theme research. This browser remembers that you voted. Multiple votes are allowed. Each new submission is saved separately with a vote number and grouped by browser identifier. Previous votes remain saved. Another browser, device or clearing browser storage creates a separate group.
themes.previewHint: Previewing does not select a vote
themes.previewNote: Interactive color study · Demo messages · No connection to your account
themes.demoNote: This is a local color preview. Your live mailbox is unchanged.

poll.storageBlocked: Please allow browser storage to save votes and group submissions from this browser. You can still preview the themes.
poll.earlierSaved: Earlier votes from this browser are saved.
poll.multipleAllowed: You may vote more than once. Each new submission adds a separate vote; previous votes remain saved. We group votes using a browser identifier.
poll.pendingStatus: Your last submission has not been confirmed. Retry will resend that saved submission without selecting its choices here. It will not be counted twice.
poll.freshForm: A fresh form is ready for the next voter. Previous votes remain saved.
poll.missing: Select at least one theme in every group. Still needed: {list}.
poll.notOpen: Voting is not open yet. Your selections have not been submitted. Please try again later.
poll.thanks: Thank you! Vote #{n} from this browser has been saved. The form is cleared and ready for the next voter. Previous votes remain saved.
poll.failed: We could not confirm your vote. Retry this submission before changing your choices. Retrying will not count the same submission twice.

mailbox.body: This message demonstrates the selected theme around a reading view. The message itself stays on a neutral background, so long text remains easy to read.
